title: End cards: equal stat cells, plain chips, a Haul label line
why: The critic scored the Extracted and Killed cards 3 of 5: stat cells of unequal width, an amber bar on every chip, Haul as big as its number, a 13px feedback link. Now four equal 140px cells with no dividers, a 1px chip border, a 20px Haul label over the 56px figure, an 18px feedback link. Restyle only.
now: End cards: tidier stat row and chips, the Haul label above the figure.
